documentationCitation.kind: shipped documentation of the refusal contract: HTTP 200 with stop_reason refusal and stop_details categories cyber, bio, frontier_llm, reasoning_extraction, general_harms
documentationCitation.note: matches the installed SDK's RefusalStopDetails.category union; the port treats the category as opaque text

ownedDecisions: The recovered extractor also requires a message-level isApiErrorMessage flag that a streamed SDK message does not carry here, so the condition is the stop reason alone; broader, and inert unless a provider refuses.
The explanation is flattened to one line and bounded to 1024 characters because journal records reject control characters and the recovered explanation is free text.
implementation.noChangeOwed: Skipping the refused message's tool calls needed no new code: the turn loop already refuses to run tools when the stop reason is not tool_use and writes an error result naming the stop reason, which is what the recovered module reaches by materializing skipped calls with a denial kind.

notPorted.reason: the recovered path re-sends the refused turn once and its notice says it is continuing; this runtime ends the turn, so the notice text is deliberately not reused

regressions: The full suite covers the session, CLI and structured-output paths this touches; no previously passing case changed and only the new refusal cases were added.
limitations: The refusal path is verified against an owned SSE fixture and unit fixtures, not against a real provider refusal.
The recovered retry, fallback chain and retraction remain unported, so this runtime's behaviour on a refusal is a strict subset of the recovered one.
